backup.production_rule: One NEW definer function (staff_decide_direct_booking_v1) granted to authenticated. No table or row is changed; the service_role-only grant on decide_direct_booking is restated exactly as production already has it. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: gate_denied_to_anon
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_decide_direct_booking_v1(uuid, text, text, uuid)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: gate_is_security_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.staff_decide_direct_booking_v1(uuid, text, text, uuid)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: inner_function_still_service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.decide_direct_booking(uuid, text, text, uuid)', 'execute')

rollback.safe_until: always (drops one new function; decisions already recorded stay)

feature_flags.name: dashboard_calls_the_gate
feature_flags.required_state: The admin dashboard build that calls staff_decide_direct_booking_v1 is published only AFTER this release is applied; the currently published build calls decide_direct_booking and fails closed either way.

compatibility.evidence: New function only. Rehearse on Alfred with supabase/tests/database/staff_decide_direct_booking.sql before apply.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
